title: ACFO: Structure guided reuse and composition of rotationally structured operators
description: ACFO provides geometry-prepared Fourier operators and computational constructions from rotational coefficient structure. Version 0.4.0 adds an executable validation supplement for structure guided factor reuse, finite-basis composition and perturbation-support updates. The supplement contains four-system replication on two Linux hosts (uniaxial slab, radial 4f relay, curved-detector WAXS tangents and weighted ODT), with five fresh processes per system and host; the separately frozen local elliptic perturbation sweep, matrix-free CPSWF preparation comparisons, basis-closure experiments and affine-family controls; numerical arrays, per-process timings, figure source data, original protocols and a portable verifier. Results identify workload-dependent advantages and boundaries: large-grid CPSWF preparation can improve over randomized preparation; intermediate spaces can require more modes than the input; small elliptic corrections can be cheaper while larger corrections favor rebuilding; repeated relay workloads can amortize compression while single-use cold workloads lose; WAXS streaming offers a distinct memory/time tradeoff; ODT core gains have small whole-operation effects. External ODT validation compares the same prepared normal action. The local historical cases remain distinct from the new two-host replication. Public metadata is privacy-normalized, with original/public digests recorded and numerical arrays preserved. Previous releases remain available.
